title: Reference approach: Scientific Image Analysis Pipeline
approach: Define the scientific question, inputs, units, output, and domain assumptions.
Separate loading, validation, calculation, and reporting into reusable functions.
Compare the selected SciPy method against a known result, residual, or independent approach.
Test normal, boundary, invalid, and non-finite inputs as applicable.
Record package versions, parameters, uncertainty, and known limitations.
acceptance_guidance: Validate array shape, dtype, and intensity assumptions.
Measure regions and validate a batch-processing pipeline.
explanation: Reference design for Scientific Image Analysis Pipeline. This file provides solution guidance rather than claiming a complete reviewed production implementation. All project data should be synthetic or properly licensed.
